thesis: The speakers argue that healthcare transformation will likely be driven by startups that are both AI-native and healthcare-native, as incumbents face significant inertia in adopting new tools. They suggest that successful AI products may function like hiring new employees or creating new business units rather than just being tools, potentially allowing standalone companies to operate with internal efficiencies superior to traditional provider groups.
